  related_gqt == 3 & livewmf_gqt == 1 ~ "Step family",
  related_gqt %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Other",
  .default = "Unknown"
)
notes: Derived from the household roster per project decision (roster items chosen over the unlabelled livewith_gqt summary). Respondent (related_gqt: 1 = mother, 2 = father) is assumed resident; livewmf_gqt = 1 means the child's other mother/father is resident; livewpar_gqt = 1 means a partner who is not the child's parent is resident. Unticked checkboxes (0) treated as genuine absence per decision. partial because (a) livewith_gqt disagrees for ~30 respondents (livewith = 1 with the mother/father box unticked; these classify as Single parent, so that level may be somewhat inflated) and (b) 4 respondents ticked both livewmf and livewpar and classify as Two biological/adoptive parents by rule order. Non-parent respondents: step-parent respondent with resident biological parent = Step family (n = 1); guardian/foster = Other (n = 1). Questionnaire non-completers (~32%) = Unknown per missing_rule
